methods.name: from_env
methods.summary: Returns a new [`EnvFilter`] from the directives in the configured environment variable. If the environment variable is unset, no directive is added.

methods.name: from_env_lossy
methods.summary: Returns a new [`EnvFilter`] from the directives in the configured environment variable, ignoring any directives that are invalid.

methods.name: parse
methods.signature: fn parse<S: AsRef<str>>(&self, dirs: S) -> Result<EnvFilter, filter::directive::ParseError>
methods.summary: Returns a new [`EnvFilter`] from the directives in the given string, or an error if any are invalid.

methods.name: parse_lossy
methods.signature: fn parse_lossy<S: AsRef<str>>(&self, dirs: S) -> EnvFilter
methods.summary: Returns a new [`EnvFilter`] from the directives in the given string, *ignoring* any that are invalid.

methods.name: try_from_env
methods.summary: Returns a new [`EnvFilter`] from the directives in the configured environment variable, or an error if the environment variable is not set or contains invalid directives.

methods.name: with_default_directive
methods.summary: Sets a default [filtering directive] that will be added to the filter if the parsed string or environment variable contains no filter directives.

methods.name: with_env_var
methods.signature: fn with_env_var(self, var: impl ToString) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets the name of the environment variable used by the [`from_env`], [`from_env_lossy`], and [`try_from_env`] methods.

methods.name: with_regex
methods.summary: Sets whether span field values can be matched with regular expressions.
